Overview

Juticalpa is a city in OL with a population of 80,000. The capital of Olancho department, an agricultural and cattle-ranching center in eastern Honduras. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
